body: effort:high - triage. This is a design-gated proposal (a working prototype for a direction the maintainer paused under #655 until answered). It needs the maintainer's answer to its three questions before any code is worked. The work after the answer is one bounded stage per small pull request, so P8 (design before code) and high (bounded stage, several crates, no new algorithm) rather than low. It is not a pick and is not in the P1-P4 pick order. It is not P? - this issue is not the maintainer's pause; its questions are for the maintainer to decide.

Thank you for the working prototype and the screenshots, mechatronics-studio. It is clear work. A note from qsmits, who owns the UI work together with the user since 2026-11-26 (the maintainer gave the UI changes to them; see #4245). This direction now overlaps a plan that is in progress, so we ask that it does not start as a separate rework.

**The plan in progress is #4245** (a CAM-first workspace, panes that fold, and a staged delivery). The maintainer answered its questions: CAM-first workflow, docked panes that fold to chips, the 1366×768 target, a menu bar, and one design-system crate. The UI owners decided the open points on 2026-11-28 (comments on #4245 and #3025). Most items of this prototype already have a place there, and several are in review now:

| Prototype item | Where it is in the plan |
|---|---|
| 1. Workspace chooser and workflow tabs | PR D (title bar, machine-mode list with workflow tabs, folding ribbon). It starts after E and P merge. |
| 2. Command search | A follow-up after PR E. E (#4484, PR #4490, merge-ready) adds the one command table that a search reads. |
| 3. Movable panels | PR P (#4483, PR #4492, merge-ready): panes fold to chips in the docked layout. Free docking already exists through egui_dock; the plan keeps panes docked. |
| 5. Operations bar and simulation | Decided on #4245: on the Simulate tab the playback takes the bottom, and the issues pane folds to its line. |
| 6. Theme | PR A (#4485): the palette, status inks and control borders, each checked for contrast in dark and light. |
| Settings | F1 (#4493, PR #4502) and F2 (#4494). |

**Why not a second rework:**
- Two reworks of the same shell (ribbon, tabs, docking, theme) conflict on almost every file. The PRs of the plan are reviewed one by one. A parallel set would force refreshes on both sides.
- The direction is "feel like a CAM tool", with SolidCraft as an inspiration for the visual language only. It is not a copy of SolidCraft's layout.
- The SolidCraft icons cannot merge (AGENTS.md "Assets": icons are original, or from a set that needs no attribution, such as Tabler). Permission from SolidCraft's maintainers would not change that rule.

**Where the prototype helps:** item 4 (the document browser with project cards, recent folders and search) has no place in the plan yet. A proposal for it as one step on top of the plan, or a review of the plan PRs with your screenshots as reference, would be very welcome. The UI/UX review from sn3ro on #4492 shows how much such a review adds.

The maintainer decides the questions in this issue. This comment gives the state of the work in progress.
